books.intro: Sahih al-Bukhari bon Imam Muhammad al-Bukhari (d. 256 AH/870 CE) (rahimahullah) nang am kembong hadith ye tobon fat cap gu. Am tobon fat bo tet gum am Yislam em tobon unanggim unanggim gu Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) nang am Sunnah tobon yaha inom fat iyap sinom capsiyang. Am 97 buk wet 7500 hadith fap sinom tobon cap gu. Am translation bo Dr. M. Muhsin Khan nang capsiyang.

Sahih Muslim bon Imam Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj al-Naysaburi (rahimahullah) nang am kembong hadith ye tobon fat cap gu. Am tobon fat bo Prophet (ﷺ) nang am Sunnah tobon yaha inom fat iyap capsiyang, nang Sahih al-Bukhari sinom "Sahihain" ma "Sahih Yare" cap gu. Am 57 buk wet 7500 hadith fap sinom tobon cap gu. Am translation bo Abdul Hamid Siddiqui nang capsiyang.

Sunan an-Nasa'i bon Imam Ahmad an-Nasa'i (rahimahullah) nang am kembong hadith ye tobon fat cap gu. Am tobon fat bo Prophet (ﷺ) nang am Sunnah tobon yaha tobon buk kembong 6 (Kutub as-Sittah) iyap capsiyang. Am 52 buk wet 5700 hadith fap sinom tobon cap gu.

Jami` at-Tirmidhi bon Imam Abu `Isa Muhammad at-Tirmidhi (rahimahullah) nang am kembong hadith ye tobon fat cap gu. Am tobon fat bo Prophet (ﷺ) nang am Sunnah tobon yaha tobon buk kembong 6 (Kutub as-Sittah) iyap capsiyang. Am 46 buk wet 4400 hadith fap sinom tobon cap gu.

Sunan Ibn Majah bon Imam Muhammad bin Yazid Ibn Majah al-Qazvini (rahimahullah) nang am kembong hadith ye tobon fat cap gu. Am tobon fat bo Prophet (ﷺ) nang am Sunnah tobon yaha tobon buk kembong 6 (Kutub as-Sittah) nang am buk 6 iyap capsiyang. Am 37 buk wet 4341 hadith tobon cap gu.

Al-Muwatta (naman yaha "kana tet kembong" ma "tet yaha am capsiyang") Imam Malik ibn Anas nang century 8 wet tobon cap gu, Yislam tobon yaha am jurisprudence kembong fatiyap capsiyang. Am Prophet (ﷺ) nang am hadith (marfu) sinom Companions (mawquf) ma Successors (maqtu) nang am law fatiyap tobon cap gu, Medina unanggim nang am law fatiyap capsiyang.

Sunan Abi Dawud bon Imam Abu Dawud Sulayman ibn al-Ash'ath as-Sijistani (rahimahullah) nang am kembong hadith ye tobon fat cap gu. Am tobon fat bo Prophet (ﷺ) nang am Sunnah tobon yaha tobon buk kembong 6 (Kutub as-Sittah) iyap capsiyang. Am 43 buk wet 5274 hadith tobon cap gu. Imam Abu Dawud nang letter Makkah unanggim nang buk yaha, terms yaha, methodology yaha fat capsiyang.
